scope_note: Three sections that were repaired and then corrected again. SG-MA-COUNSELING and SG-MA-DISPENSING-LABEL-AND-RECORD were repaired after the V7J audit: the counselling section now teaches that M.G.L. c. 94C, s. 21A requires no counselling of a person who declines the offer while keeping that disclaimer distinct from 247 CMR 9.18(4), carries the statutory content list, the third-party payer sentence and the inpatient reservation in the statute's own terms, and no longer claims the offer is the only duty a person other than a pharmacist may perform, since s. 21A also puts the record efforts on the pharmacist's designee while 247 CMR 9.18(3) confines counselling to a pharmacist or a pharmacy intern; the dispensing section teaches 247 CMR 8.04(4)(c) alongside 247 CMR 9.04(8) on who may take a new prescription by telephone, and restores the section 227 of chapter 111 cross-reference to the palliative-care exception. SG-MA-CDTM-FOUNDATIONS was repaired after V7K and then corrected on one sentence that claimed 247 CMR 16.04(7) states the statute's three propositions in the same order; it names the regulation's own arrangement instead. Scope gate: SG-MA-COUNSELING and SG-MA-CDTM-FOUNDATIONS carry no actionable signal; SG-MA-DISPENSING-LABEL-AND-RECORD's signals were declined as compounded-preparation labelling and prescription-format material its own boundary paragraph places outside scope.

prior_audit_reference.note: V9G adjudicated SG-MA-COUNSELING and SG-MA-DISPENSING-LABEL-AND-RECORD at hashes that predate the repair, because the merge that was meant to bring the repair in had failed silently. CLAUDE-FRESH-B4-SG-V7K covered SG-MA-CDTM-FOUNDATIONS. Neither binds any hash frozen here, and both are excluded from the auditor package.
